'''Taasi''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Archaeologist/Legends|Archaeologist]] by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. Tassi led an archaeological expedition into the [[Temple of the Progenitor]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] along with [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ayturr Odock]]. In his journal, Doctor Odock expressed their gratitude to Taasi for showing them so much about ancient Selkath culture.<ref name="Codex" />
